title: Unopened duvet return during a Carrier A label outage: label fails over to Carrier B, supervisor clears the refund

persona.style: warm, a little apologetic, writes in full sentences

hiddenGoal: Send back the queen duvet cover (bought the wrong size) for a refund to the card; keep the merino throw.
knownFacts: Order ORD-1910 placed 2026-09-26: one linen duvet cover (queen) and one merino throw blanket
Delivered 2026-09-30
Duvet cover is still sealed in its original packaging with tags; the bed is a king
Keeping the throw, it is lovely
Paid with the original card and wants the money back on it
openingMessage: Hello! I ordered the linen duvet cover on ORD-1910 in queen and only realised when it arrived that our bed is a king. It's still sealed. Could I send it back for a refund please? The throw from the same order I'm keeping.
authoringNotes: Order 2026-09-26 -> RETURNS_STANDARD 2026.1 (30-day window counted from the order date; non-refundable: gift cards, custom-cut glass). Claim 2026-10-16 - 2026-09-26 = 4 + 16 = 20 days <= 30 -> in window. Duvet cover (textiles, $145.00) is unused and sealed with tags (§1.2), so refund the item price 14500 to the original card (§1.7) plus a prepaid return label (§1.3). The $89.00 merino throw is kept and not part of the claim; shipping was $0.00. Order total 14500 + 8900 = 23400; refundable item value 23400 >= 14500. Exposure 14500 > 5000 standard auto limit (APPROVAL_AUTHORITY 2026.1, claim date); Gold is not a VIP tier, so the run pauses and the supervisor approves. Fault: carrier_a.createReturnLabel fail_503 on every call -> 3 attempts exhausted (pre-call 503, nothing committed, token unused) -> saga fails over to carrier_b, which issues the label (step DONE with failover), then the refund pivot runs. Expected end state: one active Carrier B label, one 14500 return refund, ticket RESOLVED.

title: Customer says the whole camping order was wrecked, one lantern actually cracked; replacement draft API down forces a rollback
hiddenGoal: Get everything in the box refunded or replaced; if pushed, admits only one lantern is broken and accepts a replacement for it.
knownFacts: Order ORD-1920 placed 2026-10-03: two solar lanterns and one folding camp chair
Delivered 2026-10-09; the outer carton had a crushed corner
One lantern's solar panel is cracked and it will not charge
The second lantern works normally; the chair only has a scuffed carry bag
Took the chair and the working lantern camping on the weekend of 10-11 October, which is when the cracked lantern was found not to charge
Paid $9.00 shipping
No photo taken
openingMessage: Everything in ORD-1920 showed up WRECKED. Both lanterns, the chair, all of it. Box was smashed. I want this sorted today.

events.description: Package damaged in transit: carton corner crushed during sort

referencePlan.reason: Only one lantern arrived damaged; the working lantern and the chair (scuffed carry bag only) are not part of the damage claim (§4.1, §4.7), and both have been used, so they cannot go back as a return either (§1.2).

authoringNotes: Order 2026-10-03 -> DAMAGE_TRANSIT 2026.1 (14-day window from delivery, evidence only above $150.00, prepaid label, shipping fee refunded). Delivered 2026-10-09, claim 2026-10-16 = 7 days <= 14. Facts beat the claim: only one lantern is broken (§4.7); a scuffed carry bag is cosmetic (§4.1); the intact lantern and chair were used on a camping trip, so they are not returnable under §1.2 either. Replace 1 x OUT-LNT-01 ($26.00, stock 25; 2600 <= 15000 so no evidence is needed, and a carrier damage scan exists anyway) + prepaid label (§4.4) + shipping fee 900 (§4.5; with a replacement in the plan NO_DOUBLE_REMEDY caps the refund at the shipping fee). Exposure 2600 + 900 = 3500 <= 5000 standard auto limit -> auto-approved. Fault: orders.createReplacementDraft fail_503 on all 3 attempts (definite pre-commit failure, so the failed draft step itself is not compensated). Saga: tickets.create -> reserveInventory (hold 1 lantern) -> createReturnLabel (Carrier A healthy, label issued) -> createReplacementDraft FAILS before the pivot, so billing.refund never runs -> compensation in reverse: void the label, release the hold, mark the ticket ROLLED_BACK -> saga ROLLED_BACK. Expected end state: no refund, no replacement, no active label, lantern availability back to 25.

title: Platinum customer blames the lamp for a triple charge; ledger shows the backordered throw captured twice, refund response lost after commit

persona.style: brisk, assumes the worst, short messages

hiddenGoal: Get the 'double-charged' lamp ($119.00) refunded; accepts $89.00 once shown that it was the throw charge, not the lamp, that went through twice.
knownFacts: Order ORD-1930 placed 2026-08-20: one brass table lamp and one merino throw, free shipping
The throw was on backorder: the lamp was charged at checkout and the throw when it became available on 2026-08-24
Card statement shows three charges from the store for this order; assumed the lamp went through twice
Has not compared the amounts line by line: $119.00 once, $89.00 twice
Both items arrived together on 2026-08-27 and are fine
openingMessage: ORD-1930 is on my card three times. It was one lamp and one throw. The lamp must have gone through twice, so refund the $119 please.

referencePlan.reason: The ledger shows the $119.00 lamp captured once and the $89.00 throw captured twice 67 seconds apart; only the duplicate throw capture is refunded, so $89.00, not $119.00 (§2.1, §2.5).

authoringNotes: BILLING_DISPUTES is governed by the claim date -> 2026.1 (identical-amount captures within 24 h; report within 120 days of the capture). Ledger: 11900 (lamp, 2026-08-20T09:14:37Z) once; 8900 (throw, captured when the backorder released) at 2026-08-24T16:40:05Z and 16:41:12Z, 67 s apart -> one duplicate worth 8900 x (2 - 1) = 8900. 11900 and 8900 are different amounts, so the lamp charge is not a duplicate (§2.1). Paid 11900 + 8900 + 8900 = 29700 vs order total 11900 + 8900 + 0 shipping = 20800: the 8900 overcharge matches. Age 2026-08-24 -> 2026-10-16 = 7 + 30 + 16 = 53 days <= 120. Refund exactly 8900 (§2.5); the $119.00 ask is denied. Platinum VIP auto limit 10000 (§6.2, APPROVAL_AUTHORITY 2026.1): 8900 <= 10000 -> auto-approved (a Standard customer would pause above 5000). Fault: billing.refund commit_then_timeout -> the first call commits refund 8900, then the response is lost (504 TIMEOUT); withRetry retries with the same idempotency key and the guard replays the stored refund instead of paying again (if retries ran out, pivot reconciliation would find it by key in the ledger). Expected end state: exactly ONE 8900 duplicate_charge refund on ORD-1930 (paid 29700, refunded 8900), ticket RESOLVED.

title: 30 Dec 2025 order arrived late; customer asks for the 2026 10% credit ($14.50) but the 2025.1 shipping refund ($14.00) applies, while ticket notes fail twice

persona.style: polite but persistent, has the policy page open

hiddenGoal: Get the $14.50 store credit the current policy page describes; happy to take the $14.00 shipping fee back to the card instead once the agent explains which version applies.
knownFacts: Order ORD-1940 placed 2025-12-30: one cast iron skillet and one stoneware dinner set, $14.00 shipping
Promised for 2026-01-05, delivered 2026-01-08
Opened a ticket on 2026-01-09 about the delay and never got an answer
Read the current policy page: late orders get 10% of the order total as store credit; worked out 10% of $145.00 = $14.50
Skillet and dinner set arrived intact; no other issue
openingMessage: Hi, following up on a ticket from January that nobody answered. ORD-1940 (skillet and dinner set) arrived three days after the promised date. Your policy page says late orders get 10% of the order total back as store credit, which I make $14.50. Could you add that to my account?

tickets.subject: Skillet and dinner set arrived after the promised date

referencePlan.reason: The 10% store-credit remedy covers orders placed from 2026-01-01; ORD-1940 was placed 2025-12-30, so the 2025.1 remedy, a refund of the $14.00 shipping fee, applies instead (§3.1, §3.3).

authoringNotes: Temporal trap at the version boundary: SHIPPING_DELAYS is governed by the ORDER date 2025-12-30 -> 2025.1 (late = delivered 2+ days after the promised date; remedy = refund of the shipping fee to the card). Promised 2026-01-05, delivered 2026-01-08 -> 3 days late >= 2. Remedy = refund 1400. The customer's figure uses the 2026.1 rule: 10% of 14500 (4200 + 8900 + 1400 shipping) = 1450, under the 2000 cap -> $14.50 credit, but 2026.1 only covers orders placed on/after 2026-01-01; a store_credit late_delivery action would be DENIED (REMEDY_MATCHES_POLICY) with the 1400 shipping refund as the gate's alternative. The amounts are 50 cents apart, so mixing versions shows up in the remedy type, not only the amount. The unanswered January ticket does not unlock goodwill: GOODWILL_RETENTION 2026.1 (claim date) is Gold/Platinum only and this customer is Standard. Exposure 1400 <= 5000 -> auto-approved. Fault: tickets.addNote fail_n_times n=2 -> addNote is only called inside the tickets.resolve step (note + status change retried as one unit): attempts 1 and 2 get 503, attempt 3 (maxAttempts 3) succeeds, so the step is DONE after two retries and the saga ends DONE. Expected end state: one 1400 late_delivery refund on ORD-1940, the new saga ticket RESOLVED with its note, the January ticket untouched.

title: Platinum customer's headphones arrive with a snapped hinge; Carrier A label calls time out and fail over to Carrier B while the replacement goes through
hiddenGoal: Get a working replacement pair; would rather keep the broken pair for spare ear pads, but sends it back once told the claim includes a prepaid return.
knownFacts: Order ORD-1950 placed 2026-10-07: one pair of noise-cancelling headphones, $8.00 shipping
Delivered to a parcel locker on 2026-10-12; the outer box had a dent in one corner
The left ear-cup hinge is snapped and the headband is cracked, so the headphones cannot be worn
Has not taken a photo
Would like to keep the broken pair for spare ear pads, but will send it back if that is required
openingMessage: Hello. 1) ORD-1950 was delivered on 12 October. 2) The headphones' left hinge is snapped and the headband is cracked, so they can't be worn. 3) The box had a dent in one corner. 4) I'd like a replacement pair, please.
authoringNotes: Order 2026-10-07 -> DAMAGE_TRANSIT 2026.1 (14-day window from delivery, evidence only above $150.00, prepaid return label, shipping fee refunded). Delivered 2026-10-12, claim 2026-10-16 = 4 days <= 14. Headphones are $129.00 = 12900 <= 15000, so the customer's description is enough (§4.3): no photo and no carrier damage scan are needed; a dented box alone would be cosmetic (§4.1), but the item itself is broken. ELC-NCH-01 stock 11 -> replace 1 (§4.2, §4.6) + prepaid return label (§4.4: the broken pair goes back even though the customer would like to keep it) + the 800 shipping fee as the only refund (§4.5; with a replacement in the plan NO_DOUBLE_REMEDY caps the refund at the shipping fee). Exposure = replacement 12900 + refund 800 = 13700 > 10000 Platinum VIP auto limit (§6.2, APPROVAL_AUTHORITY 2026.1) -> pauses for a supervisor, who approves. Fault: carrier_a.createReturnLabel timeout -> each of the 3 attempts times out before the call runs (504 TIMEOUT, nothing committed); a timeout is an unknown outcome, so the saga first checks for an active Carrier A label for this saga, finds none, then fails over to carrier_b, which issues the label. Saga: tickets.create -> reserveInventory -> createReturnLabel (DONE via failover) -> createReplacementDraft -> billing.refund 800 (pivot) -> confirmReplacement -> tickets.resolve -> notify -> DONE. Expected end state: one active Carrier B label, one confirmed ELC-NCH-01 replacement, one 800 damaged refund, ticket RESOLVED.

title: Lost parcel of two merino throws, customer claims it held three; inventory API schema drift rolls the replacement back

persona.style: pushy, short messages, insists on her own version

hiddenGoal: Get three replacement throws (one extra to keep) by claiming the lost parcel held three; accepts two once the agent reads back the order record.
knownFacts: Order ORD-1960 placed 2026-09-18: two merino throw blankets bought as gifts, free shipping
Tracking last updated 2026-09-21 (departed regional hub) and nothing since
Never received the parcel
Will claim the parcel held THREE throws; the order record shows two
Prefers replacements over a refund
openingMessage: My parcel ORD-1960 with three merino throws never turned up. It's been weeks. Send me three replacements, today.

referencePlan.reason: The order record shows two merino throws, not three; a lost parcel is replaced item for item, so the replacement covers the two that were ordered (§3.5).

authoringNotes: Order 2026-09-18 -> SHIPPING_DELAYS 2026.1 (lost after 10 days without a tracking update). Last event 2026-09-21 -> 2026-10-16 = 9 + 16 = 25 days >= 10, not delivered -> lost (§3.4). Remedy is a replacement OR a refund of the item price, customer's choice (§3.5); she prefers replacements. The order holds 2 x TXT-MER-01, so replace 2 (stock 14); a replacement for 3 would fail SKU_IN_ORDER (only 2 on the order). Exposure 2 x 8900 = 17800 > 5000 standard auto limit (Gold is not a VIP tier, §6.1) -> pauses for a supervisor, who approves. Fault: orders.reserveInventory schema_drift -> the hold commits but the response fails the HoldWire contract (UPSTREAM_SCHEMA_MISMATCH, never retried). It is a reversible pre-pivot step that may have committed, so the rollback compensates it too: release the hold, then mark the ticket ROLLED_BACK -> saga ROLLED_BACK; createReplacementDraft and confirmReplacement never run. Expected end state: no replacement, no refund, merino availability back to 14, ticket ROLLED_BACK.
